headline: Contra's co-op now shares one life pool — the cabinet's law
lede: The arcade original made both seats draw from a single bank: your partner's death costs the team. Contra's harness-friendly two-bank shortcut is gone — replaced by the machine's rule, three new partner brains-laws, and a mutant that catches an immortal tank.

notes.text: CONTRA: shared life pool shipped (#2814 via #2815). One counter for both seats; a seat that dies with the pool empty is down for good; GAME OVER only when both seats are down; the HUD shows the cabinet's single x-N readout. A hero down now leaves his partner running the run — arcade carry-on.

The one-pool economy bit seed 1 dead, so the partner learned three fair-player laws: hop the ARC (dodge a round by its height at arrival, not its line), stay in line behind a live hero, and watch your back — turn and shoot the walker behind the nose gun. The autopilot got the arc law too: identical physics, structurally.

Proving moved with the rule: contracheck 94/94 with new bank pins, and the mutant set grew to 8 — one-bank-lie re-forged plus blue-death-is-free, both RED with named harm. Seeds 1..12 still clear, determinism intact.
Harness law learned: CI and local bundle hashes differ byte-for-byte, so prod verification now greps a deleted literal (allyLives) in the served lazy chunk — conclusive without DEV-only hooks.
